title: Grateful Dead Live at Lanai Theater on 1969-11-15

ai_review.summary: Crystal‑clear 1969 soundboard capture of a high‑energy Crockett show highlighted by an epic, 42‑minute Turn On Your Lovelight and tight Pigpen organ work.
ai_review.review: The recording is a classic 1969 soundboard tape with surprising clarity and warmth for its era, delivering crystal‑clear vocal harmonies and a well‑balanced mix. The performance shines especially on the marathon Turn On Your Lovelight and the spirited Casey Jones, while Pigpen’s organ‑driven numbers feel tighter than the rest of the set. Overall the show is lively and historically rich, making it a must‑have for 1969 Dead collectors.

ai_rating.rationale: All reviews are overwhelmingly positive (mostly 5‑star) and praise both the musical performance and the surprisingly good soundboard quality; a single 4‑star comment about board mix nuances slightly tempers the rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note crystal‑clear harmonies, warm and deep tone, and a scooped EQ that benefits the mix; vocals are prominent but not distracting, and overall clarity is remarkable for a 1969 SBD.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set flows smoothly with extended jams, tight Pigpen‑led organ numbers and new Workingman's Dead material, keeping the energy high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia adds strong vocal harmonies (singing with Pigpen on NTYSM) and maintains his characteristic presence.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s organ work is highlighted and described as tight, especially on his material.
